QuestionStmt.S: In a cyclic process, work done by the system is

Option1Stmt.S: more than the heat given to the system.

Option2Stmt.S: equal to the heat given to the system.

Option4Stmt.S: independent of the heat given to the system.

Solution.S:
In a cyclic process, the system returns to its initial state, so change in internal energy $\Delta U = 0$.

From the first law of thermodynamics: $\Delta U = Q - W \Rightarrow 0 = Q - W \Rightarrow Q = W$.

Thus work done by the system is equal to the heat given to the system. Hence the correct option is B.
